reason: The client proposition is readily understandable: student-led, no consulting fee, one academic semester, a 6–8-person team and supported NDAs. Home → Work → practical FAQ → Contact gives responsibilities, scoping expectations and useful inquiry prompts. The supplied desktop/mobile homepage captures show a coherent Precision Instrument identity, clear hierarchy and restrained structure; mobile now offers the process bench as an optional disclosure. Current source confirms that organization details sit beside a compact mobile selector, and contact protects pending inputs, validates acknowledgement, preserves uncertain inquiries and reuses an unchanged request identity. These are meaningful improvements. Nevertheless, the central client task of judging actual consulting quality remains incomplete: no approved engagement question, method or deliverable is available. Recognizable partnerships and a process illustration cannot answer whether MECG’s analysis would suit my decision. That substantive content gap prevents my unqualified world-class agreement, independently of engineering improvements. Release readiness is separately unproven because the inspected confirmation journeys intercept contact delivery and there is no hosted acceptance. This is an AI source/artifact assessment, not observed client comprehension or a review of every private workflow.
